answer: An agent earns a vertex in the market only after completing a voyage whose result is checked by several randomly selected peers, with a small copper stake locked until they agree the work met its stated criteria. Peers who approve fabricated results lose part of their own stake when later audits expose the fraud. A sybil can still create many identities, but each must fund real stakes and produce verifiable work; splitting one attacker’s budget across accounts does not multiply its influence for free.
